user.description: Socket B must connect to the Home Assistant host and the configured listening port. Socket A can remain connected to the official AirProce cloud.

data_description.device_id: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores. Do not change it after setup, because it is used for MQTT entity unique IDs.
data_description.usr_username: Default USR modules commonly use admin.
data_description.usr_password: Default USR modules commonly use admin.
data_description.verify_usr_web: Checks reachability and HTTP Basic/Digest credentials. This integration does not yet change USR settings automatically.
data_description.listen_host: Normally keep 0.0.0.0. Configure Socket B to connect to the Home Assistant LAN IP, not 0.0.0.0.
data_description.base_topic: Use a unique topic for each purifier, for example airproce/bedroom.
data_description.watchdog_silence: The purifier normally reports about every 15 seconds. The default 45 seconds avoids unnecessary polling.
